concept.title: Red Hat Quay high availability host capacity
concept.shortdesc: To plan host capacity for a high availability Red Hat Quay deployment, you can start from per-role CPU, memory, and disk guidance and adjust for your workload.

conbody.p: Use the following starting points per system (physical or virtual). Increase capacity for production traffic, Clair, builders, and storage growth.

ul.li: About 20 GB disk (operating system plus container storage)

dlentry.dt: Red Hat Quay and Redis hosts

ul.li: About 20 GB disk (operating system plus container storage)

dlentry.dt: Object storage hosts (when you run Ceph or similar on premise)

ul.li: At least 30 GB disk, and more based on the image storage that you need

conbody.p: For broader sample sizes across proof of concept, mid-size, and high-end deployments, see the sizing guidance earlier in this Plan guide.
